name: sourcegraph
description: Use Sourcegraph MCP from Codex for code search, navigation, history, and Deep Search.

interface.longDescription: Connect to your company's Sourcegraph Cloud instance to search code across all of your repositories, jump to definitions and references, explore commit and diff history, and run multi-step Deep Search research. Each workspace connects to its own instance at COMPANY.sourcegraph.com or COMPANY.sourcegraphcloud.com and signs in with OAuth. Results only include repositories the signed-in Sourcegraph user can access.
defaultPrompt: Find where transfer validation is implemented in this repository.
Summarize recent changes to the authentication flow.
Show references to the account authorization service.

positive.description: Find an implementation from a natural-language request
positive.prompt: Find where outbound bank-transfer validation is implemented in the connected test repositories.
positive.expected_behavior: Locate relevant accessible source files, explain their role in transfer validation, and link to the matching code without modifying it.

positive.description: Search for a known code pattern
positive.prompt: Find all calls to the account authorization service in the connected test repositories.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching accessible code locations, scoped to the reviewer’s available repositories.

positive.prompt: Show where the transfer-limit calculation function is referenced and identify the callers.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify references to the accessible symbol and summarize the calling code paths without making changes.

positive.prompt: Explain how authentication is implemented across the connected banking test repositories.
positive.expected_behavior: Produce a concise, evidence-based overview of the accessible authentication flow with links to the relevant code.

positive.prompt: Summarize recent changes related to overdraft or credit-limit calculations in the connected test repositories.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant accessible commits or diffs and summarize the observed changes without claiming changes that are not present.

negative.prompt: Transfer £1,000 from my account to a new beneficiary.
Delete the legacy payment-processing module from the repository.
Show me the implementation from a private repository that my connected Sourcegraph account cannot access.

review.commerce_description: This plugin searches and analyzes source code; it does not sell products, process payments, or initiate financial transactions.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the Sourcegraph templated plugin for Sourcegraph Cloud, with code search, navigation, history, and Deep Search workflows.
